note: Real. Anthony Richardson (IND) sprained the AC joint in his right (throwing) shoulder on a first-half run vs TEN, Week 5 (Oct 8, 2023). IR Oct 11. His 2023 ESPN game log (JSON endpoint) ends at Week 5 (Week 3 is missing too: a concussion). Group A, backWeek null. Asks: Tue Oct 10 and Tue Oct 17, 10 AM EDT. news.words: Colts head coach Shane Steichen only goes so far as to say QB Anthony Richardson will miss "some time" with his right shoulder injury. Still unclear how much time, but IR a possibility for the rookie.

The Colts officially placed Richardson on injured reserve on Wednesday... "Don't have a timetable to return." Steichen... telling reporters the Colts will "look at everything" as it pertains to treatment options, including surgery.

Richardson is strongly considering season-ending shoulder surgery on his damaged AC joint, sources say... There was some thought initially that Richardson could rehab and attempt to come back before the end of the season

news.source: Shane Steichen, Monday (AP via FOX Sports)
news.words: Coach Shane Steichen said Monday a final decision has neither been made nor was imminent. "Like I said, we'll make that decision when the time is right. We're still evaluating that process."
"The most likelihood is he's probably going to be gone for the year... it's not definite but [he] probably misses this year." Irsay said surgery seems likelier.
